channel.description: Recent content in What Is Good Software? on The CTO Trap

item.title: Team Dynamics When Your 'Team' Might Be One Person and an AI
item.description: AI changes how teams work, learn, and make decisions. Leadership must understand these shifts to maintain quality and coherence in complex systems.

item.title: Building Quality When AI Writes Most of Your Code
item.description: AI accelerates output but not judgment. Quality must be engineered deliberately in an era where most code is machine-generated.

item.title: The Leadership Failures Creating Bad Software at Scale
item.description: Bad software is rarely the result of weak engineers. It is the result of weak management decisions.

item.title: What Makes Software Good Has Changed
item.description: The definition of good software has split into two realities. Most leaders still haven’t realized it.
